landing.tagline: Independent personal finance for people who want control.
landing.headline: Take control of every account, budget, and transaction from one calm workspace.
landing.subheadline: Nexo helps you capture spending faster, explain where your money moves, and keep a reliable audit trail without handing your financial data to someone else.
landing.previewBody: Track balances, budgets, accounts, trends, SMS ingestion, and AI workflows from one place.
landing.featuresEyebrow: Why teams and individuals start here
landing.featuresSubtitle: The product reduces manual entry, improves visibility, supports English and Arabic, and keeps each financial change understandable.
landing.workflowTitle: A simple flow from capture to understanding
landing.workflowSubtitle: You do not need a separate spreadsheet, notebook, and reporting tool. Nexo keeps the flow connected.
landing.finalTitle: Start with a cleaner first mile for personal finance
landing.finalSubtitle: Open an account, choose your language, record transactions, and let the application build structure around your money from day one.

bilingual.label: Bilingual experience ready for daily use

insights.title: See patterns early
insights.description: Watch totals, account behavior, trends, and budget performance without assembling reports by hand.

control.title: Keep control of your data
control.description: Run Nexo yourself and preserve a detailed audit trail for high-trust financial records.

assistant.title: Use AI where it helps
assistant.description: Lean on built-in AI tools for financial explanations and follow-up workflows when raw numbers are not enough.

capture.title: Capture accounts and transactions
capture.description: Create your financial structure first, then add transactions as they happen across the accounts that reflect where money comes from and where it goes.

review.title: Review budgets and accounts
review.description: Organize spending with dedicated income and expense accounts plus recurring or custom budgets that reflect how money is actually used.

understand.title: Understand what changed
understand.description: Use dashboards, metrics, and audit logs to explain movement, catch anomalies, and make decisions faster.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noData: No enough data to show reports

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: Common workflows and a built-in assistant for product questions.
guide.heroTitle: Learn the core workflows before you start recording data.
guide.heroDescription: This guide explains the most common tasks in plain language so a normal user can understand what to do first, what each screen is for, and when to ask the assistant for help.

accounts.title: Set up your accounts
accounts.description: Create the accounts that represent your cash, bank, expenses, income sources, and anything else you track regularly.

transactions.title: Record money movement
transactions.description: Use transactions whenever money moves from one account to another so your balances and history stay consistent.

budgets.title: Track a focused budget
budgets.description: Create budgets for the accounts you want to watch closely so you can measure progress against a target window.

guide.commonTasksDescription: These are the paths most people follow when starting fresh or checking their finances during the week.

first.title: 1. Create your base accounts first
first.description: Start with the accounts you actually use. A simple setup might include cash, bank, salary, groceries, transport, and savings.

second.title: 2. Add transactions as money moves
second.description: When you spend, earn, or move money internally, record the movement so both sides stay visible and the running balances remain trustworthy.
